fields.name: Renderables
fields.evidence: Array of ls::RenderableObject pointers. Windows bg3.exe+0x3AFCC10 (= Toolkit ls::InstancingSystem::CreateInstancingBatchVisuals, GameEngine.dll+0x972330) moves the 0x30-byte VisualCreateResult's array (record +0x20) here (bg3.exe+0x591830) and then walks it with an 8-byte stride, attaching each object to the scene (writes the scene at object+0x38); when the batch is discarded the same array's elements are destroyed as objects. Toolkit UnloadInstancingBatchVisuals (GameEngine.dll+0x9790B0) calls RenderableObject::DetachFromScene / ~RenderableObject (0x110-byte objects) on each element. Destructor bg3.exe+0x686280 only frees the buffer (non-owning at that point).

Toolkit UnloadInstancingBatchVisuals removes the vertex buffer at +0x10 and clears it. Live: heap pointers.
